summary: Reads a 2-byte big-endian segment size from a byte stream, dispatching it together with a stored value into a parameterized dispatcher object (state code 90), then skips the remaining segment bytes via a stream callback.

operations.description: Load the stream state object from this+0x14 and its current read pointer and remaining-byte count from stream-state words 0 and 1.
If the stream has no remaining bytes, refill via the stream refill callback and reload the read pointer and count.
Invoke the refill callback stored in stream-state word 3; if it returns false, abort with 0.
Read the first byte as the high byte of a 16-bit value and advance the read pointer past it.
If only one byte remained before the first read, refill again so the second byte can be read.
Second invocation of the stream refill callback (word 3) when the stream is short; returning false aborts with 0.
Form the big-endian 16-bit size: second byte plus first byte shifted into the high byte.
Write dispatcher state: obj+0x14 = 90, obj+0x18 = stored value read from this+0x178, obj+0x1C = computed size.
Dispatch obj vtable entry at obj+0x4 with argument 1 (parameterized state dispatch).
Consume the two bytes from the stream: read pointer becomes the second-byte position plus 1, remaining count becomes the pre-decrement count minus 1.
Invoke the skip callback at stream-state plus 16 with the remaining segment byte count (size minus 2).
